transport_products:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  trip_type "TripType" NOT NULL,
  outbound_route_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  return_route_id TEXT,
  price NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  -- Administrative state. Independent from publicly_bookable (P2-2).
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  -- Independent from `active` (P2-2): a product can be administratively
  -- active but not yet offered for public/e-commerce booking, or vice
  -- versa. Defaults to false: nothing is publicly bookable until an
  -- operator explicitly opts in.
  publicly_bookable BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  CONSTRAINT transport_products_agency_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies (id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT transport_products_outbound_route_tenant_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, outbound_route_id) REFERENCES routes (agency_id, id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT transport_products_return_route_tenant_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, return_route_id) REFERENCES routes (agency_id, id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT transport_products_price_non_negative_check
    CHECK (price >= 0),
  -- Cross-column CHECK referencing the TripType enum: legitimate SQL,
  -- matches this codebase's existing CHECK-constraint style (see
  -- wishes_date_range_check etc.). Application layer still validates
  -- this at request time for a clean error message; the CHECK is the
  -- database-level backstop.
  CONSTRAINT transport_products_return_route_required_check
    CHECK (
      (trip_type = 'ONE_WAY' AND return_route_id IS NULL)
      OR (trip_type = 'ROUND_TRIP' AND return_route_id IS NOT NULL)
    ),
  CONSTRAINT transport_products_agency_id_key UNIQUE (agency_id, id)
scheduled_departures:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  departure_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  arrival_expected_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  -- Hard capacity limit (P0-2). No overbooking, no override column.
  capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
  supplier_id TEXT,
  -- Decision-backed enum (see DepartureServiceType above): varies per
  -- departure, so it lives here rather than on Supplier or Product.
  service_type "DepartureServiceType" NOT NULL,
  -- No SCHEDULED/DEPARTED/CANCELLED/COMPLETED lifecycle enum: no
  -- approved decision exists for those values, and inventing one would
  -- violate the anti-invention rule. The single boolean below is added
  -- only because it is mechanically necessary for the "hard capacity
  -- limit" rule to be meaningful once Booking exists: a cancelled
  -- departure must not count toward future availability. It carries no
  -- other workflow meaning and is not a status enum.
  cancelled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  CONSTRAINT scheduled_departures_agency_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies (id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT scheduled_departures_product_tenant_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, product_id) REFERENCES transport_products (agency_id, id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT scheduled_departures_supplier_tenant_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers (agency_id, id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT scheduled_departures_capacity_non_negative_check
    CHECK (capacity >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT scheduled_departures_arrival_after_departure_check
    CHECK (arrival_expected_at IS NULL OR arrival_expected_at >= departure_at),
  CONSTRAINT scheduled_departures_agency_id_key UNIQUE (agency_id, id)
route_points:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  route_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- Optional per point (business rule): false is the default and does
  -- not create any operational obligation.
  checkpoint_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  checkpoint_type "CheckpointType",
  -- Minutes after the future ScheduledDeparture's departure_at. Not an
  -- absolute time, not a new timezone concept.
  planned_offset_minutes INTEGER,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  CONSTRAINT route_points_agency_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies (id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT route_points_route_tenant_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, route_id) REFERENCES routes (agency_id, id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT route_points_agency_id_key UNIQUE (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT route_points_agency_route_sequence_key
    UNIQUE (agency_id, route_id, sequence),
  CONSTRAINT route_points_sequence_positive_check
    CHECK (sequence > 0),
  CONSTRAINT route_points_offset_non_negative_check
    CHECK (planned_offset_minutes IS NULL OR planned_offset_minutes >= 0),
  -- Cross-column CHECK matching this codebase's existing style (see
  -- transport_products_return_route_required_check in 003): a point
  -- flagged for operational monitoring must carry a checkpoint type
  -- to be structurally meaningful. Application layer also validates
  -- this for a clean error message; this CHECK is the DB backstop.
  CONSTRAINT route_points_checkpoint_type_required_check
    CHECK (checkpoint_required = false OR checkpoint_type IS NOT NULL)

    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT bookings_outbound_departure_tenant_fk

    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, return_departure_id) REFERENCES scheduled_departures (agency_id, id)

  -- Cross-column CHECK matching transport_products_return_route_required_check

  CONSTRAINT bookings_return_departure_required_check
    CHECK (

operation_checkpoints:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  route_point_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- Snapshotted from RoutePoint.checkpoint_type at generation time.
  -- Reuses the enum from 004_route_points.sql; not duplicated.
  checkpoint_type "CheckpointType" NOT NULL,
  arrival_checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  departure_checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  notes TEXT,
  -- Optional, manual-entry-only free text (e.g. "Posto Ipiranga BR-101
  -- km 42"). No GPS/geofencing/automatic collection of any kind.
  location TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  CONSTRAINT operation_checkpoints_agency_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies (id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT operation_checkpoints_operation_tenant_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, operation_id) REFERENCES transport_operations (agency_id, id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT operation_checkpoints_route_point_tenant_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, route_point_id) REFERENCES route_points (agency_id, id)
    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT operation_checkpoints_agency_id_key UNIQUE (agency_id, id),
  -- Generation creates exactly one checkpoint per monitored RoutePoint
  -- per Operation; this is the DB backstop against a duplicate.
  CONSTRAINT operation_checkpoints_agency_operation_point_key
    UNIQUE (agency_id, operation_id, route_point_id),
  -- DB backstop (app layer also validates for a clean 400): an
  -- ARRIVAL-only checkpoint must never carry a departure confirmation,
  -- and vice versa. BOTH allows either/both independently.
  CONSTRAINT operation_checkpoints_arrival_type_check
    CHECK (arrival_checked_at IS NULL OR checkpoint_type IN ('ARRIVAL', 'BOTH')),
  CONSTRAINT operation_checkpoints_departure_type_check
    CHECK (departure_checked_at IS NULL OR checkpoint_type IN ('DEPARTURE', 'BOTH'))

  sale_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 150),
  payment_id TEXT NOT NULL,

agency_revenue_scopes:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agencies (id),
  supplier_id TEXT,
  product_id TEXT,
  category_id TEXT,
  created_by_user_id TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  legacy_ref TEXT,
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_scopes_agency_id_key UNIQUE (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_scopes_supplier_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_scopes_product_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, product_id) REFERENCES travel_products (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_scopes_category_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, category_id) REFERENCES commission_categories (agency_id, id)
agency_revenue_rule_versions:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  version_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version_number >= 1),
  effective_from DATE NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('PERCENTAGE', 'FIXED_PER_PASSENGER', 'FIXED_PER_SALE', 'FIXED_PER_ITEM', 'NONE')),
  base_selector TEXT CHECK (base_selector IN ('LINE_TOTAL', 'NET_FARE', 'TAXES', 'FEES', 'TAXES_AND_FEES', 'MARGIN')),
  value NUMERIC(14, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (value >= 0),
  entitlement_event TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ON_FULL_SETTLEMENT'
    CHECK (entitlement_event IN ('ON_SALE_CONFIRMATION', 'ON_FULL_SETTLEMENT', 'ON_BALANCE_DEADLINE')),
  collection_model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AGENCY_COLLECTS'
    CHECK (collection_model IN ('AGENCY_COLLECTS', 'SUPPLIER_COLLECTS')),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 300),
  created_by_user_id TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  calc_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_rule_versions_agency_id_key UNIQUE (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_rule_versions_scope_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, scope_id) REFERENCES agency_revenue_scopes (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_rule_versions_version_uq UNIQUE (agency_id, scope_id, version_number),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_rule_versions_base_check
    CHECK ((mode = 'PERCENTAGE') = (base_selector IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_rule_versions_percent_check
    CHECK (mode <> 'PERCENTAGE' OR value <= 100),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_rule_versions_margin_check
    CHECK (base_selector IS DISTINCT FROM 'MARGIN' OR collection_model = 'AGENCY_COLLECTS'),
  -- Supplier-collected sales have no customer settlement to wait for.
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_rule_versions_supplier_collects_check
    CHECK (collection_model = 'AGENCY_COLLECTS' OR entitlement_event = 'ON_SALE_CONFIRMATION')
agency_revenue_entries:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  sale_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  sale_item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  supplier_id TEXT,
  rule_version_id TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING_RULE', 'FORECAST', 'ENTITLED', 'AVAILABLE', 'RECEIVED', 'CANCELLED')),
  entitlement_event TEXT,
  amount NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (amount >= 0),
  base_amount NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (base_amount >= 0),
  calc_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  memory JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  entitled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  received_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  received_amount NUMERIC(14, 2),
  received_reference TEXT,
  cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_by_user_id TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  legacy_ref TEXT,
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_entries_agency_id_key UNIQUE (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_entries_sale_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, sale_id) REFERENCES sales (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_entries_item_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, sale_item_id) REFERENCES sale_items (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_entries_supplier_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_entries_rule_fk
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, rule_version_id) REFERENCES agency_revenue_rule_versions (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_entries_pending_zero_check
    CHECK (status <> 'PENDING_RULE' OR amount = 0),
  CONSTRAINT agency_revenue_entries_received_check
    CHECK ((status = 'RECEIVED') = (received_at IS NOT NULL))
employee_commission_rule_scopes:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  employee_id TEXT,
  category_id TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  legacy_ref TEXT,
  created_by_user_id TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT ecrs_agency_fk FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT ecrs_employee_tenant_fk FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, employee_id) REFERENCES employees (agency_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT ecrs_category_tenant_fk FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, category_id) REFERENCES commission_categories (agency_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT ecrs_status_check CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ARCHIVED')),
  CONSTRAINT ecrs_agency_id_key UNIQUE (agency_id, id)
employee_commission_rule_versions:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  effective_from DATE NOT NULL,
  revised_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  revised_by TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL,
  calculation_metric TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GROSS',
  value NUMERIC(14, 4),
  apply_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TOTAL',
  excess_threshold NUMERIC(14, 2),
  progressive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  tier_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MARGINAL',
  excess_basis TEXT,
  legacy_ref TEXT,
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_scope_tenant_fk FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, scope_id) REFERENCES employee_commission_rule_scopes (agency_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_revised_by_fk FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, revised_by) REFERENCES users (agency_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_version_number_check CHECK (version_number >= 1),
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_mode_check CHECK (mode IN ('PERCENTAGE', 'FIXED', 'NONE')),
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_metric_check CHECK (calculation_metric IN ('GROSS', 'MARGIN')),
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_apply_on_check CHECK (apply_on IN ('TOTAL', 'EXCESS')),
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_tier_mode_check CHECK (tier_mode = 'MARGINAL'),
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_excess_basis_check CHECK (excess_basis IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_value_check CHECK (value IS NULL OR value >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_mode_value_check CHECK (
    (mode = 'NONE' AND value IS NULL AND NOT progressive)
    OR (mode = 'FIXED' AND value IS NOT NULL AND NOT progressive)
    OR (mode = 'PERCENTAGE' AND ((progressive AND value IS NULL) OR (NOT progressive AND value IS NOT NULL)))
  ),
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_excess_check CHECK (apply_on = 'TOTAL' OR (excess_threshold IS NOT NULL AND excess_threshold >= 0 AND NOT progressive)),
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_scope_version_key UNIQUE (agency_id, scope_id, version_number),
  CONSTRAINT ecrv_agency_id_key UNIQUE (agency_id, id)
employee_commission_rule_tiers:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  tier_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  from_amount NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL,
  to_amount NUMERIC(14, 2),
  rate NUMERIC(7, 4) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ecrt_version_tenant_fk FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, version_id) REFERENCES employee_commission_rule_versions (agency_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT ecrt_tier_check CHECK (tier_number >= 1 AND from_amount >= 0 AND rate >= 0 AND (to_amount IS NULL OR to_amount > from_amount)),
  CONSTRAINT ecrt_version_tier_key UNIQUE (agency_id, version_id, tier_number)
sale_commission_attributions:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,

  CONSTRAINT sca_agency_id_key UNIQUE (agency_id, id)
payment_method_receipt_rules:
agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,

id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,

commission_release_events:

sale_import_batches:

  agency_id TEXT NOT NULL,

  external_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(external_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  sale_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  batch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT sale_import_keys_sale_fk FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, sale_id) REFERENCES sales (agency_id, id),
  CONSTRAINT sale_import_keys_batch_fk FOREIGN KEY (agency_id, batch_id) REFERENCES sale_import_batches (agency_id, id),

agency_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES agencies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  cutover_date DATE,
  updated_by TEXT,

sale_payment_reversals:

agency_revenue_settlement_settings:

  settlement_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (settlement_mode IN ('PER_SALE','BATCH_WINDOW')),
  closing_day INTEGER CHECK (closing_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31),
  payment_days INTEGER CHECK (payment_days BETWEEN 0 AND 365),
  updated_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CHECK (settlement_mode='PER_SALE' OR (closing_day IS NOT NULL AND payment_days IS NOT NULL)),
  FOREIGN KEY (agency_id,updated_by) REFERENCES users(agency_id,id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
agency_revenue_batches:
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::text,

  window_month DATE NOT NULL CHECK (extract(day FROM window_month)=1),
  window_start DATE NOT NULL,

  expected_payment_date DATE NOT NULL CHECK (expected_payment_date>=window_end),
  policy_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (agency_id,id),
  UNIQUE (agency_id,window_month),
  FOREIGN KEY (agency_id,created_by) REFERENCES users(agency_id,id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
agency_revenue_batch_entries:

  entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount>=0),
  PRIMARY KEY (agency_id,entry_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (agency_id,batch_id) REFERENCES agency_revenue_batches(agency_id,id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  FOREIGN KEY (agency_id,entry_id) REFERENCES agency_revenue_entries(agency_id,id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
agency_revenue_batch_receipts:
agency_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agencies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  batch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  reference TEXT CHECK (length(reference)<=200),
  received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (agency_id,batch_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (agency_id,batch_id) REFERENCES agency_revenue_batches(agency_id,id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  FOREIGN KEY (agency_id,created_by) REFERENCES users(agency_id,id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
